name: Dry Eye Dialogues
description: TBUT, osmolarity, meibography, lipid/aqueous/mixed DED, IPL, LipiFlow, scleral lenses for OSD, Demodex, and the chronic dry eye management ladder.

episodes.title: The Tear Film: Three Layers, One Function
episodes.description: Lipid, aqueous, and mucin — the structure that keeps the ocular surface healthy and clear.

episodes.title: Dry Eye Disease: The New Definition and the DEWS Report
episodes.description: The multifactorial disease of tears and ocular surface — loss of homeostasis as the unifying concept.

episodes.title: Aqueous-Deficient DED: The Lacrimal Gland Failure
episodes.description: Sjögren’s, age, and radiation — when the gland cannot make enough aqueous.

episodes.title: Evaporative DED: The Meibomian Gland Problem
episodes.description: MGD as the dominant cause of DED — the obstruction, the atrophy, and the lipid deficiency.

episodes.title: Mixed Mechanism DED: The Most Common Presentation
episodes.description: Why most patients have both components and why treating only one fails.

episodes.title: TBUT: The Tear Breakup Time and How to Measure It
episodes.description: The fluorescein technique, the timing, and the thresholds that separate normal from abnormal.

episodes.title: Schirmer Test: The Aqueous Production Check
episodes.description: With and without anesthesia, the 5-mm threshold, and the patient preparation that matters.

episodes.title: Osmolarity: The Objective DED Biomarker
episodes.description: Why osmolarity elevates in DED, the variability between eyes, and the role in staging.

episodes.title: Ocular Surface Staining: Patterns and Severity
episodes.description: NEI grid grading, the corneal versus conjunctival staining, and what the pattern tells you.

episodes.title: Meibography: Imaging the Glands You Cannot See
episodes.description: Reading the infrared meibography, grading gland loss, and the torsional shadow that signals dropout.

episodes.title: Lid Margin Assessment: The Anterior and Posterior Survey
episodes.description: Telangiectasia, crusting, orifice plugging, and the expressibility test that completes the MGD workup.

episodes.title: Demodex: The Mite That Lives in the Lash
episodes.description: The cylindrical dandruff, the epilation microscopy, and the tea tree oil protocol.

episodes.title: Blepharitis: Anterior Versus Posterior and the Overlap
episodes.description: Staphylococcal, seborrheic, and MGD — the three forms and the tailored management of each.

episodes.title: Artificial Tears: The First-Line Ladder
episodes.description: Choosing the right drop — viscosity, preservatives, lipid content, and the dosing that follows.

episodes.title: Lipid-Based Tears: The Evaporative DED Fix
episodes.description: Why lipid-containing drops help MGD patients and the emulsion chemistry that delivers them.
